// A single planar contact. Position is the world contact point in meters;
// Normal points from body A toward body B; Penetration is the overlap depth;
// NormalImpulse and TangentImpulse are the solver impulses in newton-seconds
// along the normal and tangent (0 before solving).
type ContactPoint2D
    implements IValue
{
    Position: Point2D;
    Normal: Direction2D;
    Penetration: Length;
    NormalImpulse: Impulse;
    TangentImpulse: Impulse;
}
